example-reference-identity.title: Confusing reference identity with value equality
example-reference-identity.short: Equal content and the same object are different concepts
example-reference-identity.summary: A logic-pitfall example where the program compiles but the result differs from the programmer's intent.
example-reference-identity.why: Conditions can be wrong when identity and value equality are treated as the same thing.
example-reference-identity.tips: Replace this with an equality pitfall appropriate for the target language.
